'''Sirty''', designated '''CT-36/732''', was a [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone commando]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Ord Cestus Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a logistics expert. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Sirty took part in a demonstration of a [[JK-13|JK]] [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] at the [[T'Chuk Sporting Arena|T'Chuk Colliseum]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He was quickly defeated by the JK in under forty-two seconds. Because of this brief encounter with the bio-droid, [[Jangotat|Nate]] recruited him as a fellow squad member on a [[Mission to Ord Cestus|mission]] to destroy the JK droids' manufacturing plants on Ord Cestus.
